dialogues.speaker: Missing Person Poster
dialogues.text: #Looking for a missing young {F#male}{M#female}. Has {F#blond}{M#blonde} hair, wears exotic clothes. Any information/assistance is greatly welcomed.

dialogues.speaker: Missing Person Poster
dialogues.text: If you have any information, please approach your nearest Millelith soldier, or report the matter directly to the Ministry of Civil Affairs. Thank you.
